blurb: Pirates Cove Diving offers scuba diving charters to Milwaukee area shipwrecks with experienced guides and a Coast Guard certified vessel. They provide boat slip rentals at Jerry's Dock Marina and Jerry's Silo Marina with crane services and dock building. Equipment rentals including dry suits are available with specific rental agreements.
